module.purpose: Registers the editor's default store side effects for embed sizing, hover updates, cropping transitions, editing transitions, and cleanup.
module.summary: This module installs a centralized side-effect registration on an editor instance. It resolves embed aspect ratios only after user-created or user-modified embed shapes, updates hovered shapes when camera movement becomes idle, synchronizes cropping and editing state with selection tools, and handles a special text-tool-lock transition. The returned disposer unregisters the side effects and cancels pending hover updates.
module.businessContext: Supports an interactive diagram editor's shape embedding, selection, cropping, and text-editing workflows. Failures can leave embeds incorrectly sized or tools and editing state inconsistent.
functions: registerDefaultSideEffects (~L9-89): Installs editor store side effects and returns cleanup logic
resolveEmbedAspectRatio (~L10-14): Resolves and persists an embed's actual aspect ratio

moduleContractTests.scenario: A user creates an embed shape.
moduleContractTests.then: the embed shape's resolveAspectRatio method is called
moduleContractTests.rationale: User-created embeds must resolve their document-mutating aspect ratio once after creation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An embed shape is created from a remote peer or document load.
moduleContractTests.then: the embed shape's resolveAspectRatio method is not called
moduleContractTests.rationale: Remote and loaded documents already contain resolved dimensions.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A user changes the URL of an existing embed shape.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Changing the embed URL can change its real aspect ratio.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The editor camera transitions into the idle state.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Hovered-shape state is refreshed only after camera movement settles.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A cropping shape is assigned while the editor is not already in the crop state.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Cropping state must synchronize the active tool.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The active cropping shape is cleared while the editor is in the crop state.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ending a crop must return the editor to the idle selection tool.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The disposer returned by registration is invoked.
moduleContractTests.then: the registered side effects are unsubscribed and cancelUpdateHoveredShapeId(editor) is called
moduleContractTests.rationale: Disposal must remove callbacks and cancel pending hover work.

detail.name: registerDefaultSideEffects
preconditions: editor provides the side-effects registry and the editor APIs used by the registered callbacks.
postconditions: Default side-effect handlers are registered for shape, instance, and instance_page_state changes.
The returned cleanup function can be used to unregister the side effects.
invariants: Embed aspect-ratio resolution is triggered only for user-created embed shapes.
Embed aspect-ratio resolution on shape changes is triggered only for user changes to an embed's URL.
Hover state is updated when the camera transitions to idle.
Crop and editing tool transitions are synchronized with the corresponding instance-page-state changes.
edgeCases: A shape created by a non-user source does not trigger embed aspect-ratio resolution.
A non-embed shape, or an embed whose URL is unchanged, does not trigger embed aspect-ratio resolution.
Entering crop state switches to select.crop.idle only when the editor is not already in select.crop.
Leaving crop state switches to select.idle only when the editor is currently in select.crop.
Starting shape editing selects select.editing_shape; text editing while tool-locked and originating from text.pointing or select.resizing includes isCreatingTextWhileToolLocked: true.
Stopping shape editing switches to select.idle only when the editor is currently in select.editing_shape.
stateMutations: Registers and later unregisters editor side effects through editor.sideEffects.

units.name: resolveEmbedAspectRatio

detail.name: resolveEmbedAspectRatio
preconditions: The argument is an embed shape compatible with TLEmbedShape.
The editor provides an embed shape utility with a resolveAspectRatio operation.
postconditions: The embed shape utility's resolveAspectRatio operation has been invoked with the supplied shape.
Any document mutation required to record the resolved aspect ratio is performed by the shape utility.
invariants: Aspect-ratio resolution is delegated to the embed shape utility.
The operation does not return a value.
edgeCases: A shape with an unusual or unresolved embed URL is passed through to the shape utility unchanged; this function does not provide fallback handling.
Errors raised while obtaining the embed shape utility or resolving the aspect ratio propagate to the caller.
stateMutations: The document state may be mutated by the embed shape utility while resolving and recording the shape's aspect ratio.
detail.summary: Resolves the actual aspect ratio for an embed shape through the editor's embed shape utility. The resolution is performed as a document side effect rather than during rendering.
